name: service-designer-app
description: Aplicação web de apoio ao trabalho de service design, do briefing ao blueprint.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace backend & npm run dev --workspace frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.build:deploy: npm run db:generate --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.start:deploy: npm run db:push --workspace backend && npm run start --workspace backend
